title: A Choir for the Ember Anew
author: Wendell Nystrom
blurb: Astrid Eastwick, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
